arStrings.szText:
Your {c_important}Grenades{/c} gain {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|+%|]{/c} increased Size and deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|x%|]{/c} increased damage.

Enemies damaged by {c_important}Grenade{/c} Skills become either {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} or {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds.
